results.title: Travel for free in Al Quoz on the ‘Bus on Demand’ until August 16
results.description: Dubai: Getting around Al Quoz is about to become easier from tomorrow, with the Roads and Transport Authority’s (RTA) Bus on Demand expanding their service network to the area. In an announcement on its official social media channels, Bus on Demand confirmed that service will now include the Al Quoz area, and as part of the launch promotion, passengers can enjoy unlimited free rides on the service from Wednesday, July 30, until August 16 as part of the launch promotion. What is Bus on Demand? Bus on Demand is an RTA-operated shared transport service that allows passengers to book a bus through a mobile app instead of waiting at a fixed bus stop. The service is designed for shorter trips within designated communities, with passengers selecting both their pick-up and drop-off locations. Outside promotional offers like the ones launched for Al Quoz, the standard fare is AED 5 per trip. Payment can typically be made using a nol card or your credit card. How to get the free rides in Al Quoz From tomorrow, you will be able to book rides in the Al Quoz area through the Bus on Demand app. You can book a ride by following these steps: Download the ‘Dubai Bus on Demand’ app, which is available for Apple and Android users. Click on ‘Get started’. Enter your mobile number. You will receive a one-time password via SMS on your number. Enable location services for the app, which will then pick up on your current location. If you are in an area which is not part of the service zones, you will see the notification ‘Out of Zone’. Select the number of passengers. Ensure the location is accurate and move the location pin if required. Next, select your drop-off point, by entering the name of the location, or selecting it on the map. For the current promotional service, both your pick-up and drop-off points should be within the service area in Al Quoz. Next, select the bus you wish to take. You may see multiple options, with buses scheduled to arrive in the area. Confirm your booking, and make sure you are at the location in time for when the bus arrives. To know more about the Bus on Demand service, read our detailed guide here .

results.title: Reported Stolen Car from Charles County Leads to Arrest and Drug Charges for Hughesville Man
results.description: Dante David Dantonio Jr., 36, of Hughesville, faces a felony charge of unlawful taking of a motor vehicle in Charles County and misdemeanor charges in St. Mary’s County of unauthorized removal of a motor vehicle, possession of a controlled substance other than cannabis and possession of drug paraphernalia. The allegations involve a gray 2012 Honda Civic that an adult female victim said Dantonio had been permitted to use for work but failed to return after leaving his job. In an application filed July 11, 2026, the victim wrote, “Dante Dantonio Jr. was using my car to go to work. On Wed 7/8/26 I found out he was not using my car to go to work. He had quit his job. So I told him to return my car on Wed 7/8/26 and he has not returned it.” The victim continued, “I informed him again on Thurs 7/9/26 and Friday 7/10/26 and again on Sat 7/11/26 but he has still not returned my car. I have not heard from him by phone nor other communication since 7/6/26.” She described the vehicle as a gray 2012 Honda Civic with a missing front grille and damage to the driver’s-side door.
